meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 已连接 xAI 时,Claude 会用 x_search 搜 X(Twitter)上的帖子,给时效性查询加日期范围、限定可信账号,每条结论附上 x.com 链接;未连接时明说不可用并改用 web_search。
howto.when: 当你提到 X/Twitter 搜索、tweets、「大家在 X 上怎么说」等关键词,或要求查社交信号时触发;仅在 xAI 账号已连接、x_search 可用时生效。

say.text: X 上最近一周对这家公司财报的反应如何?
say.note: 会做关键词搜索并去掉回复噪音。

say.text: 把这条帖子的回复和引用抓下来:<x.com 链接>
say.note: 会做一次 thread fetch 查询。

howto.what_en: With xAI connected, Claude uses x_search to search X (Twitter): it date-bounds time-sensitive queries, scopes trusted accounts, and cites an x.com URL per claim. Without a credential it reports x_search unavailable and uses web_search.
howto.when_en: Triggers on X/Twitter search, tweets, or social-signal requests, including asking what people are saying on X; it only runs when an xAI account is connected and x_search is available.

say_en.text: Search x_search for yesterday's NVDA talk, only from @growth_papa
say_en.note: Runs a handle-scoped search with a date bound.

say_en.text: What has X been saying about this company's earnings over the past week?
say_en.note: Runs a keyword pass with reply noise removed.

say_en.text: Fetch the replies and quotes for this post: <x.com link>
